milestones.name: Obtain Forebear's Legacy
milestones.note: Permanent damage upgrade found in the northeast corner of a room in The Dwellings, just before the ACAT boss fight

milestones.name: Defeat ACAT
milestones.note: Defeating ACAT unlocks a shortcut back to The Spine

zones.name: The Dwellings
zones.fingerprintHint: Icy cave environment with large frozen pipe/tentacle structures and metal grating; blue-tinted lighting

zones.name: The Spine
zones.note: Area connected via shortcut unlocked after defeating ACAT

zones.name: Metropolis
zones.note: Area reached after passing through The Dwellings; mentioned as containing tough bosses

zones.name: Haven
zones.note: Area mentioned alongside Metropolis as containing tough bosses

abilities.name: Forebear's Legacy
abilities.note: Found in the northeast corner of a room in The Dwellings, just before the ACAT boss. Four more exist but are found much later (10–15 hours of gameplay).

bosses.name: ACAT
bosses.note: Subtitle reads 'Nacre Engraver'. Encountered just after the Forebear's Legacy pickup. Defeating him unlocks a shortcut back to The Spine.

objectives.name: Grab Forebear's Legacy before ACAT
objectives.hopDescription: In The Dwellings, head to the northeast corner of the room just before the ACAT boss arena to collect the Forebear's Legacy damage upgrade.
objectives.note: Strongly recommended to collect before fighting ACAT to ease upcoming boss fights in Metropolis and Haven

objectives.name: Defeat ACAT (Nacre Engraver)
objectives.hopDescription: Fight and defeat the boss ACAT in The Dwellings to unlock the shortcut back to The Spine.

connectors.description: Main story progression path leads from The Dwellings into Metropolis.
Shortcut unlocked after defeating ACAT, allowing fast travel back to The Spine.
connectors.note: Only available after ACAT is defeated
